name: University of Sussex
description:
The University of Sussex is a public research university located in the southern coastal county of Sussex in England.

More than a third of the university's students are studying a postgraduate qualification, as one in three are international students.

The university offers over 400 undergraduate programmes and 210 postgraduate programmes. It is ranked 19th in the UK in the 2021 Times and Sunday Times University Rankings.

What is the University of Sussex acceptance rate for International Students?

The University of Sussex acceptance rate is 92%.

  • The Library is located in Library Square, with vast study spaces and books available. 
  • The campus contains:
  • Sports Centre and Falmer Sports Complex (Sussex Sport), Post Office, Union Shop, Health Centre, Dentist, Pharmacy, Conference Centre, Attenborough Centre for the Creative Arts, Chaplaincy and Meeting House, Childcare Centre, Laundrette.

Sussex is a wealthy area in South England, enjoying moderately good weather. There are plenty of scenic places to go for walks and picnics in summer, plus the party town of Brighton is only 10 minutes away by train.

Student Life

A standout feature of student life at Sussex University is One World Week, a series of events that aim to raise awareness of global issues and highlight international opportunities for the diverse Sussex student population. There is also a Coaching Programme that offers life counselling and a Student Centre. The University of Sussex is the 25th most international university in the world.

Queensland is a popular study destination for international students as the internationally recognised institutions prime students for readily available success beyond graduation. Cultural tours are frequently held to celebrate the locationâ€™s diversity, and tourists often like to tour the Great Barrier Reef. The Sunshine Coast and Gold Coast provide relaxing beach spots to unwind between classes, and students are tempted to explore the famous outback.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a prestigious public research university with a vibrant campus life and global recognition? The University of Sussex might be your perfect fit. Ranked among the top universities in the UK, Sussex offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across various fields. These include Business, Law, Social Sciences, Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Media, Arts, and more.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: At the University of Sussex, you’ll be part of a Students' Union that’s home to over 200 societies, from academic and cultural clubs to sports and hobbies. Whether you’re into tech, theatre, politics, or just want to meet people with similar interests, there’s a community for you.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Sussex offers a range of modern and comfortable accommodation options on and off campus. You can choose from various types of university-managed halls, each providing a mix of private and shared rooms.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At the University of Sussex, you’ll find an extensive library with a wide range of print and digital resources to support your studies. You can access the library 24/7 during term time.

Sports
If you enjoy staying active, the university has fantastic sports facilities, including a gym, sports halls, tennis courts, and fields for outdoor activities. You can also join one of the university’s sports clubs or participate in recreational sessions.

Laboratory
You’ll find many state-of-the-art laboratories across various disciplines, including engineering, environmental science, and biology.

Cafeteria
With several cafes and eateries, you’ll find everything from grab-and-go options to sit-down meals. These include the Arts Piazza, Attenborough Centre, the Veg Bowl at Dhaba, the Library cafe and more.
